tests.title: Paired retrieval experiment: short vs long title of the same record in an offline index

predictions.magnitude: short variant ranks at least 3 positions higher on average

tests.compatible_with_both: A rank gain of 1 to 3 positions: too small to separate retrieval from noise.
tests.unexpected_under_both: Long variants rank clearly higher (difference below -3 positions).

decisive_intervention.description: For each of 200 records, randomise which title variant (original long vs shortened, same key terms) is indexed first; the abstract is held fixed.

sensitivity.smallest_useful_effect: 3 rank positions on the first results page
sensitivity.expected_noise: SD of paired rank difference about 5 positions (pilot of 20 records)

decision_rule.continue_if: 95% CI of the mean paired rank gain lies above 0 and the point estimate is at least 3.
decision_rule.revise_if: CI above 0 but entirely below 3 positions: real but too small; test the informativeness variant V1.
decision_rule.stop_if: CI entirely below 1 position (equivalence to no useful effect).
decision_rule.indeterminate_if: Any other outcome; report it, do not extend n after looking.

equivalence.method: CI entirely inside the margin (two one-sided tests)

feasibility.data: 200 open records with abstracts (public metadata dump); an offline BM25 index built locally
feasibility.human_time: about 4 hours to write shortened titles under a fixed rule
feasibility.technical_risk: the shortening rule may drop key terms; guarded by the positive control

l0_leakage_control.why_not: No language model judges anything in this test.

proxy_vs_target.proxy: rank in an offline BM25 index
proxy_vs_target.target: retrieval by real readers of the records
proxy_vs_target.how_kept_apart: The card states that the result bears on the index mechanism only; citations are T2's business.

variants.selection_rule_fixed_before: One shortening rule (drop subtitle and stop words), fixed before indexing; no other rule is tried.

positive_control.description: Records whose shortened title drops the query term must lose rank.
positive_control.distinguishes_bug_from_refutation: If they do not lose rank, the index or the query is broken and a null result says nothing about H1.

data_split.design_data: the 20 pilot records used to set the SD
data_split.confirmation_data: 200 other records drawn after the rule was fixed
data_split.separation: Pilot records are excluded from the confirmation sample by identifier.

tests.title: Within-journal comparison of citations by title length, with an LLM rating of title clarity

predictions.magnitude: within-journal citation ratio short/long at least 1.10
predictions.unit: ratio of mean citations, short over long titles
ratio of mean citations, short over long titles

tests.unexpected_under_both: A within-journal ratio below 0.95 (long titles cited more).

decisive_intervention.description: Permute title length within journal-year strata to build the null; negative control: page count, which neither hypothesis links to retrieval.

sensitivity.expected_noise: overdispersed counts; bootstrap SE of the log-ratio about 0.04 at n = 2000 per arm
sensitivity.replications: 2000 short and 2000 long titles within the same journal-years
sensitivity.simulation_not_applicable: Count data with overdispersion: the two-arm normal model of sim.py does not fit; the permutation null plays this role.

feasibility.data: open citation counts for preprints posted in 2022-2023
feasibility.technical_risk: journal of record missing for unpublished preprints

l0_leakage_control.description: L0 control: the same LLM rates the titles alone and must not predict citation rank above chance; if it does, its clarity rating leaks hindsight (C-075) and is dropped.

proxy_vs_target.proxy: citations at two years after posting
proxy_vs_target.target: being read and used by other researchers
proxy_vs_target.how_kept_apart: Stated as a limit; no claim about use.

variants.selection_rule_fixed_before: Length in words and in characters both reported; words is primary, fixed now.
variants.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction over the two length measures; only the primary (words) can trigger continue.

positive_control.description: Known effect of open access on citations must be recovered in the same pipeline.
positive_control.distinguishes_bug_from_refutation: If the open-access effect is not recovered, the pipeline is faulty.

data_split.design_data: 2021 preprints used to choose the strata
data_split.separation: Disjoint by posting year, checked by identifier.

ranking.basis: value of information for the next decision relative to cost

scenarios.name: retrieval works
scenarios.if: T1 shows a gain of at least 3 positions
scenarios.then: run T2 to see whether the gain reaches citations
scenarios.why: T1 is cheap and removes the mechanism doubt first.

scenarios.name: retrieval does not work
scenarios.if: T1 is equivalent to no gain
scenarios.then: stop; T2 would only measure prestige
scenarios.why: Without retrieval the idea has no lever.
